description:
Company: MeroxIO IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Experience: 01 Year
Salary: 1.8 LPA 2.4 LPA
Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated Shopify Web Designer & Front-End Developer who is passionate about website development, eCommerce, and modern AI-assisted development.

This is an entry-level role where you will work on Shopify stores, customize themes, implement designs, build front-end features, and use modern AI coding tools to improve development speed and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop responsive Shopify websites and storefronts.
  • Customize Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Convert Figma/design layouts into responsive Shopify pages.
  • Develop and customize sections, templates, landing pages, product pages, collection pages, and other storefront components.
  • Implement UI/UX improvements and CRO-focused features.
  • Troubleshoot and fix front-end and Shopify theme issues.
  • Optimize websites for performance, responsiveness, and usability.
  • Work with senior developers and project managers to deliver Shopify projects.
  • Use AI tools to assist with coding, debugging, research, documentation, and problem-solving.
  • Maintain clean, organized, reusable, and maintainable code.

Required Skills

  • 0–1 year of experience in web development or Shopify development.
  • Basic to good knowledge of Shopify and Shopify themes.
  • Good understanding of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
    • Shopify Liquid
  • Understanding of responsive web design.
  • Ability to understand and implement designs accurately.
  • Good problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Good knowledge of prompt writing / prompt engineering.
  • Comfortable working with AI-assisted development tools.

AI & Modern Development Skills — Must Have

The candidate should be comfortable using AI as part of their daily development workflow.

Must have working knowledge or willingness to work with:

  • OpenAI Codex
  • Claude Code
  • AI-assisted coding and debugging
  • Writing effective development prompts
  • Using AI to understand existing code
  • Using AI for troubleshooting and optimization
  • Reviewing and improving AI-generated code rather than blindly accepting it

We are looking for someone who understands that AI is a development assistant, not a replacement for understanding code.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Shopify Online Store 2.0.
  • Knowledge of Shopify JSON templates and sections.
  • Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub.
  • Basic understanding of SEO and website performance.
  • Experience working with Figma.
  • Knowledge of Shopify apps and third-party integrations.
  • Basic understanding of CRO and eCommerce best practices.

Who We Are Looking For

This role is suitable for a fresher or someone with up to 1 year of experience who:

  • Loves building websites and experimenting with new technologies.
  • Is curious about AI and modern development workflows.
  • Can learn quickly and solve problems independently.
  • Has a strong eye for design and attention to detail.
  • Can write clear prompts and communicate effectively with AI coding tools.
  • Is willing to continuously learn Shopify and front-end development.

Salary

1.8 LPA – 2.4 LPA, depending on skills, technical ability, and interview performance.

Why Join MeroxIO?

  • Work on real-world Shopify and eCommerce projects.
  • Opportunity to work with established brands and growing D2C businesses.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify development, CRO, SEO, and performance optimization.
  • Learn and work with modern AI development tools such as Codex and Claude Code.
  • Opportunity to grow into a full-fledged Shopify Developer / Front-End Developer.

If you are a fresher who loves coding, Shopify, design, and AI, we'd love to hear from you.
